press-not-pointer.undoes: Hm — a pointer press puts the page in pointer mode

tab-not-keyboard.undoes: Hk — Tab or Shift+Tab, with any modifier, is keyboard navigation (even when nothing takes the focus)

tab-without-modifiers-only.undoes: Hk — Option+Tab (Safari's way to buttons) is keyboard navigation too

every-key-keyboard.undoes: Hm — a key that leaves the focus where it is does not switch the ring on (Chromium's own :focus-visible rule)

focus-move-after-key-keyboard.undoes: Hm-move — a key pressed after a click that the page follows with a focus move (Esc giving the focus back to a dialog's opener, Enter opening one, the window getting it back) does not switch the ring on: the first build's rule M3, put back (review round 1, R20-2)

every-focus-move-keyboard.undoes: Hm — a focus move after a pointer press (a click that opens a dialog) stays pointer

press-in-bubble-phase.undoes: Hm — the press is seen in the window's capture phase, before a block control stops its propagation

key-in-bubble-phase.undoes: Hk — Tab is seen in the window's capture phase, before an open dialog stops every key there (ConfirmModal)

not-installed.undoes: Hm — the tracker runs in the app (main.tsx installs it before anything renders)
not-installed.why: the unit tests install the tracker themselves; fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-zoombar reads the ring in Chromium, the one engine that draws it after a click and a key

ring-not-gated.undoes: Hm — the house ring (outline and radius) is not drawn in pointer mode, nor the browser's own: both CSS rules taken away
ring-not-gated.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-zoombar reads it in Chromium

no-pointer-suppression.undoes: Hm — in pointer mode the browser's own ring is off on buttons too (the house rule's gate alone leaves Chromium's `auto` ring on a button styled without `all: unset`)
no-pointer-suppression.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-sweep presses every button outside the sheet in Chromium

house-ring-not-gated.undoes: Hm — the house rule itself is gated (its 4 px radius, not only its outline, is off in pointer mode)
house-ring-not-gated.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; with the suppression rule in place the outline stays off, so only the house rule's 4 px radius differs, on a button whose own corners are neither inline nor 4 px: none in the editor (every button there sets its radius inline), so fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-public-menu reads the public pages' menu button (6 px) in Chromium

keyboard-ring-suppressed.undoes: Hk — the suppression applies in pointer mode only: keyboard navigation keeps the house ring
keyboard-ring-suppressed.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-tab-sweep reads every button the keyboard reaches

no-ring-before-input.undoes: Hk — before any input the ring follows the browser's :focus-visible, as before the fix (the gate reads 'not pointer', not 'keyboard')
no-ring-before-input.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-script-before-input focuses the zoom bar's buttons by script with no input before, in Chromium

links-not-suppressed.undoes: Hm (siblings) — in pointer mode the browser's own ring is off on links (the sidebar's Postr and Back to My Posters)
links-not-suppressed.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-siblings presses every focusable element outside the sheet that is not a button or a text field, in Chromium

checkboxes-not-suppressed.undoes: Hm (siblings) — in pointer mode the browser's own ring is off on checkboxes (an author's Corresponding and Equal contrib.)
checkboxes-not-suppressed.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-siblings presses every focusable element outside the sheet that is not a button or a text field, in Chromium

summary-not-suppressed.undoes: Hm (siblings, review round 1, R20-1) — in pointer mode the browser's own ring is off on <summary> disclosures (the table's tips, the sign-up page's email preferences, the pricing page's "What's included")
summary-not-suppressed.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-mouse-summary clicks each summary and presses each non-Tab key, in Chromium

keyboard-other-targets-suppressed.undoes: Hk — links, checkboxes and <summary> disclosures keep the browser's own ring for keyboard navigation (their suppression is in pointer mode only)
keyboard-other-targets-suppressed.why: jsdom draws no focus ring; fit-check.mjs focus-tab-sweep reads every button, link and checkbox the keyboard reaches, and focus-tab-summary each summary reached by Shift+Tab
